1 Fire.
--2 Love.
--3 Time.
--4 The rainy season or autumn.

तिथिः m. or f. [अत्-इथिन् पृषो˚ वा
ङीप् cf. Uṇ. 4. 2]
1 A lunar day;
तिथिरेव तावन्न शुद्ध्यति Mu. 5;
Ku. 6. 93, 7. 1.
--2 The number ‘15’.
--Comp.
--ईशः the regent of a
lunar day.
--क्षयः {1} the day of new
moon. {2} the day on which a
tithi begins and ends without one
sunrise or between two sunrises.
[]
--पत्री an almanac.
--पालनं
observance of the rites prescribed
for the several lunar days.
--प्रणीः
the moon.
--वृद्धिः f. the day in which
a tithi is completed under two
suns (one which comprises two
sunrises).
